rules.text: When entering Combat, draw the bottom card of
your discard pile.
While your Bulma Ally is in play, capture a Dragon
Ball. Banish after use.

Deck or discard pile for a Drill and place it into
play.
All Villain opponents must play with their
hands revealed.

When defending in Combat, stop the first
unstopped attack against you. Banish after use.

card when an energy attack against you is
successful.

use.

at the same time.

cannot be discarded or banished unless you

damage.

lower it 1 Personality level.

lower it 1 Personality level.

your opponent's Life Deck until you reveal a
Dragon Ball. Set it aside, shuffle their Life Deck,
then place that Dragon Ball at the bottom.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Capture 2 of your opponent's
Dragon Balls and place them at the bottom of
their owners' Life Decks. Do not use their powers.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Restart this Combat with new
cards and restore all damage to the values at the
start of this Combat.
